steps.text: Dear Kal'tsit,
Glad to receive your letter. Hope you and everyone in Babel are well.
A couple of months ago, I rescued a girl by the name of Amiya from a convoy that had met with misfortune.
The accident killed her parents and afflicted her with Oripathy.
The locals deal with orphaned Oripathy patients by putting them in a car and driving them into the wastes. I had no choice but to take her with me.
We have become fellow travelers by chance.
You can't imagine my panic and helplessness as I took care of her...
Fortunately, a woman who goes by the name of Savage has joined our little band, which has helped take some of the burden off me.
A shadow leaps out of the dunes in the moonlight.
(Approaches cautiously)
(Threatening roar)
Hey! Go away!
Don't come any closer!

steps.name: Massive Sandbeast
steps.text: (Rubs claws excitedly)

steps.name: Young Sandbeast
steps.text: (Moves head in confusion)

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You seem to have made them even more excited, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't worry, Doctor, I can deal with this!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mum and Dad taught me how to chase the sandbeasts away. All you need to do is imitate the sound of their natural enemies.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Chirp, chirp...

steps.name: Massive Sandbeast
steps.text: (Pauses in confusion)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait, that wasn't right. Was it 'Chip, chip'?

steps.name: Young Sandbeast
steps.text: (Tilts head in confusion)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's still not right. What was it again?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: 'Aoww'? 'Ku, ku'? 'Tick, tock'?

steps.name: Massive Sandbeast
steps.text: (Swings tail in confusion)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's not right either...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: It's okay, Amiya. I'll take care of this.
The Doctor makes a ring with thumb and index finger, and whistles, producing a strange sound.

steps.name: Massive Sandbeast
steps.text: (Stands up startled)

steps.name: Young Sandbeast
steps.text: (Looks around uneasily)

steps.name: Massive Sandbeast
steps.text: (Quickly digs a hole)

steps.name: Young Sandbeast
steps.text: (Slowly follows)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wow, Doctor! That was just like the real thing!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let me try!
Amiya presses her tiny hand against her lips, but used too much force, and only gets a sound out after going all red and puffy in the face.
The pair of whistles echo across the wastes, sending the sandbeasts scurrying underground.
A child's laughter replaces the whistles.
Then the laughter fades away to silence, and a soft little sigh.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Come here, Amiya.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Why the sullen look? The sandbeast ran off.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I could never remember, even after Mum and Dad taught me so many times... and I couldn't protect you, even though I said I would.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Your hand's still wounded... it hasn't fully healed.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Don't worry, it doesn't hurt. Anyway, don't you remember?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: It was you who taught me how to make that sound.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I did?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You see? Like I told you, your brain slows down and you start to forget things, if you don't sleep.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... I don't want to sleep.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm scared that I'll dream of... those things.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: But you told me you dream of your parents too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: We have some time before our ride gets here. Have a sleep.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Can I come closer?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: When I wake up... the first thing I want to see is you.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Of course. Why don't I tell you a few stories while we wait for Savage?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: A long time ago, there was a really smart scientist...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Her home was in danger, and she made a difficult choice to protect it and the people around her...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Doctor, I found a vehicle! We'll be able to go to the next—

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: (Whisper) Shh, she's sleeping.
Dear Kal'tsit, I was glad to find signs of life wherever I went.

This should be an unfamiliar world, yet there are times when it feels incredibly familiar. I recall the legends that had fascinated me in the past, never failing to capture my imagination despite their age.
The ancient machines that had rumbled in the mines and dust once again roam this land.
Stories can become reality, and the reality we see can become stories.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You can come over, Amiya. No need to keep poking your head out from there.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you drawing, Doctor? Am I interrupting?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Of course not.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Take a look. Is it good?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's the mining truck we just drove together!

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I've been drawing lots of our experiences.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Have you driven a mining truck before? Even the old miners can't go as fast as you did.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I've seen many amazing vehicles before. Like Originium slug eggs, but much larger. Once, I drove one of them...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: ...and went through the bridge between stars.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The bridge between stars? It's always dark at night, so it must've been really dark! Was it dangerous?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: No. Guides stand by the bridge, borrowing glowing clouds from old stars and making round mirrors out of them.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Follow the path the mirrors show, and we can...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We can...?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: See the spires fading in and out of the clouds, and the crown of flowers worn by the stars, on the other side of the bridge.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: When we descend on the crown, you'll find that it belongs to good children like you. It's a really, really big playground.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A playground? I've read about them in the stories... there are lots of children there.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Do you want to play with other children?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No. I... I just want to play with you, Doctor.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You'll make more friends as you grow up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As I grow up...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's the most amazing vehicle you've ever driven?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: The most amazing...? Well... I spent a very long time with it. Very long indeed.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Was there anyone else with you?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: In the beginning, yes. In the end, though, I was alone.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: ...But it's alright. I was sleeping. I slept for a very long time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Take me with you next time! That way, I can keep you company and you won't have to sleep all day.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: ...Hehe.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why are you laughing, Doctor?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: That's a big promise to make. Are you sure?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You'll have your own journey, your vision, your future... are you sure you want to be with me?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But they all say that... there's no future for people with rocks on them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So... I'll always be with you...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: We'll have a future, Amiya.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: How's Amiya doing? Still not great?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hm... still a bit of fever. Maybe Oripathy complications from all the excitement. Hard to find Oripathy meds around these parts.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: She acts like it's nothing during the day, but keeps having nightmares. Poor girl...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Every survivor of that accident was infected. No exceptions.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: How long does it take for Oripathy to progress in a child her age?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: It's different for everyone. Some disintegrate the day after developing acute symptoms. Some suffer for more than a decade of misery.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But the end is always the same.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Oripathy... is there anyone in the world who can cure it?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: The world? Oh, you mean Terra, our great land? Man, you sound like one of those old scholars. I didn't know you had a sense of humor.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Wait... you're serious?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I'm afraid not. It's impossible.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I need it to be possible.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: People couldn't imagine the nomadic cities a few centuries ago, could they?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I'll find a way, before her symptoms deteriorate. It may be hard, but that doesn't mean it's impossible.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Say it to a Rim Billy, and they'll think you're making fun of them.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You never fail to surprise me, but I just can't help but believe in you.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Is that the charm of being smart?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Come on, Charlotte.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hehe, I meant you... never mind.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Oh, I meant... hm...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Can't you tell? There's something about you... something that lets everyone know that you're different from us.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Amiya senses it. Children are more sensitive than we know.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Is it that obvious?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: She's strong. She doesn't show her sadness in front of you. She wants you to see her joy. She doesn't want to be a burden to you; she's trying to take care of you.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You became the only pillar in her life the day you saved it.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But she knows you were never supposed to cross paths. She's afraid that you'll abandon her too.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Don't worry. I won't leave her.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Now that's the spirit.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I knew you would say that.
Dear Kal'tsit, I thought I would never be more a passing visitor in this place, one history would never remember.
This intentional isolation made me forget reality: I am here, on Terra, this great land.
I don't know what made me feel it.
But the warmth of life coming from a child's palm stings my heart and makes it burn.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Jerky and fruit. Left here on purpose.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: They know I'm here?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Always inscrutable.
Dear Kal'tsit, I'm planning to take Amiya back to Babel.
Savage has done her best to find medicine for Amiya, but my ability to treat Amiya's Oripathy is limited under present conditions.
I know that Amiya isn't special, by any objective standard. I know that Babel faces a crisis no less complicated, but I've decided to bring her back.
I met many people along the way. I've fretted over money at times, benefitted from people's generosity at others. I've seen new things, even some that surprised me for the first time in a long while.
The convoy that we were traveling with broke down. We found a herder to guide us through the wilderness of Rim Billiton on the backs of burdenbeasts, to the rumbling of drills and engines.

steps.name: Burdenbeast
steps.text: (Licks docilely)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Good boy, good boy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are we really not going to Yan, Doctor?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: We're going somewhere else, to cure your sickness.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... there's no cure for Oripathy...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: There's no such thing as an impossible puzzle, Amiya.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: There's a place called Babel, where people I trust are working hard to fight this disease.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Let's work with them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Will I have to spend a long time there?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Some time, at least. But don't worry, there'll be a lot of people with you, caring for you. I'll be there, too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... do we really have to go?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Lots of sick kids went away to get treated, but no one came back...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oripathy doesn't hurt at all.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I promise I'll be good, Doctor. Right, Savage?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Yes... Amiya has always been a good girl.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Are you sure you don't want to rethink this, Doctor?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Billies deal with Originium every day. We know what Oripathy can do.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Stay here in Rim Billiton, and at least we can give her... a home.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Maybe that's more important than the cold walls of a laboratory.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: ...A home.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You have a point. But I can't just stand by and watch Originium hurt her... I have an obligation.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Amiya, I promise you, I'll do my best to cure you, no matter what happens.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Savage does have a point, though, and Babel is in a place that's not entirely safe.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You can stay with Savage, if you don't want to leave Rim Billiton.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I'm sorry to force this decision on you at such a young age... but you're a strong girl, and we'll respect your choice.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: The Doctor's right, Amiya. No need to knee-jerk an answer. Think carefully about it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I trust you, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I want to have a future. I want to grow up, read books with you, travel with Savage. I...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's just that... I'm a little scared...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Thank you, Amiya.
The Doctor pats Amiya's head, then picks her up and climbs onto the burdenbeast.
They've hardly sat down when the ground begins to shake, stirring up clouds of dust.

steps.name: Burdenbeast
steps.text: (Growls in alarm)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: —Underneath our feet!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Must be a deep digger! It's spooking the burdenbeast! Watch out!

steps.name: Burdenbeast
steps.text: (Panicked cry)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Stay, boy, stay! Whoa!

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hang in there, Doctor!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor!
The burdenbeast rears up on its hind legs, gives a loud cry, then charges forward.
The rest of the pack follows.
They run towards a shallow shoal, splashing water everywhere.
It is all the Doctor can do to grab the fur on the back of the burdenbeast and hang on for dear life.
Amiya's eyes are wide-open in the chaos.
With one hand on the burdenbeast, she stretches out the other towards the Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Grab my hand, Doctor!

steps.name: Burdenbeast
steps.text: (Angry roar)

steps.name: Burdenbeast
steps.text: (Accelerates)

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I have to get them to—whoa!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hang on! It's speeding up!

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I'm—try—ing!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hang in there, Doctor! I'm coming!

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Hur—ry!

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Whooooaaaahhhh—!
In the end, I was thrown from the back of the burdenbeast into the water.
My hindquarters and back burned with pain, and I gagged on the water rushing into my nose.
But it also made me feel like I was truly living on this land, after spending almost half a year traveling across it.
I heard the sound of my life surging.
Summer, 1091
Kazdel

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ...No more Messenger stations from here on.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Villages become sparse, and bandits become frequent...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I'm afraid we have to part ways here, Savage.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: The region ahead is in turmoil. You'll be in danger, if the mercenaries spot you.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You and Amiya will be in danger too, won't you?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I'll be fine! I've come this far, I'll see your journey through to the end.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Charlotte... thank you.
The Cautus's ears quiver at the mention of her real name. She glances at the Doctor.
A few months is neither long nor short.
True, it comprised only a tiny part of her lifetime, but it was also a span of a few hundred days, filled with countless unforgettable experiences.
Under the setting sun, before the sandbeasts, beneath the eaves. Upon this land.
She had enjoyed the journey, even if she never fully understood her quiet companion, and the many strange and curious ideas that companion had.
The Cautus who goes by the name of Savage sighs. What can she do? She is not as smart as the Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Will you come and visit, Savage?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: The Doctor said Babel's new base is being worked on by Billy engineers, right? Maybe we'll see each other soon!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then... I'll be waiting for you, Savage.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Good girl, Amiya. Now, though, I need to figure out how to take you and the Doctor through the wilderness!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You and Amiya stay here and rest for a while, Doctor. I'll see if the transport hub ahead has any good vehicles for hire.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Do we have time to say goodbye?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: The longer we stay here, the more dangerous it gets.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: The Cautus girl seems rather determined. It's better for both of you to part ways here.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: ...I suppose you're right.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We won't wait for Savage?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Sometimes, Amiya, we have to do bad things for good reasons.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: We don't want Savage to be in danger, do we? But she doesn't want to leave you.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: It's rude to leave without saying goodbye, but that way, Savage won't face danger.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I promise, we'll get to see her again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Can I leave a note for Savage? She'll be worried if she comes back to find us gone.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Good thinking. Go ahead and write one.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Her Highness wants to meet with you, alone.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Are things not going well? How's Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Now is not the time.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: We'll leave once the girl has written her note.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Alright. Can we trouble you with the note?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Certainly. I'll leave it where she is sure to see it.
